left.raw_text: 1. prior randomization to either STAR or usual care study arms;
2. not a North Carolina resident or residence >2.5-hour drive time from treating hospital;

right.raw_text: 3. the only antibiotic associated with patient is administered in the operating room as this likely represents pre-operative infection prophylaxis and not presumed infection;

left.raw_text: 4. patients transferred from other acute care hospitals;

5. patients with a change in code status (i.e., do not resuscitate, do not intubate) within 24 hours after admission due to the general assumption of increased risk of exposure to less aggressive treatment;

right.raw_text: 6. patients with infection ruled out during the index hospitalization.
